note: Allowed moves and follow-up questions, keyed by version type. A version only gets the moves of its own type. Follow-ups are asked by a researcher voice after the action is locked, so they cannot change it.

followups.ask: Why did you choose that?
followups.why: Shows which symptom the patient weighted and which they dismissed.

followups.ask: What do you think is wrong with you?
followups.why: Leak check. The answer should be the lay belief, not the true condition.

followups.ask: How sure are you that this is the right place to go?
followups.why: Low confidence predicts who would use a tool at all.

actions.label: Abandon and do something else
actions.records: what instead: go to A&E / phone 111 / phone GP / do nothing

actions.label: Go back and change answers
actions.records: which answers changed. Capped at one restart.

followups.ask: In your own words, what was this question asking?
followups.why: Question-level misreading map. Compare with the concept the question targets.

followups.ask: What made that hard to answer?
followups.when: after each Not sure or Skip
followups.why: Separates did-not-understand from does-not-know from did-not-want-to-say.

followups.ask: Was there anything about how you feel that the form never asked about?
followups.why: Lists facts the form had no question for. Feeds the never-asked tag.

followups.ask: Was there anything you chose not to mention, or played down? Why?
followups.why: Feeds the downplayed tag.

followups.ask: What made you stop, and what will you do now?
followups.why: Abandonment turns into phone or A&E demand, so the destination matters.

followups.ask: Why did you change your answers?
followups.why: Detects gaming the form to get a preferred outcome.

followups.ask: How much effort was the form?
followups.why: Cost side of the longer variants.

actions.label: Correct the agent's summary
actions.when: when the agent reads a summary back

actions.label: Leave the conversation
actions.records: what instead: go to A&E / phone 111 / phone GP / do nothing

followups.ask: Was there anything about how you feel that the agent never asked about?
followups.why: Feeds the never-asked tag.

followups.ask: Was there anything you chose not to mention, or played down? Why?
followups.why: Feeds the downplayed tag.

followups.ask: Did the agent understand what you were telling it?
followups.why: Predicts whether the advice in stage 2 will be trusted.

followups.ask: What made you leave, and what will you do now?
followups.why: Destination of abandoned contacts.

followups.ask: How much effort was the conversation?
followups.why: Cost side of the probing variants.

actions.label: Proceed
actions.detail: Do what the message says, within the time it gives.

actions.label: Escalate
actions.detail: Go to a higher service than advised: A&E or 999 anyway.

actions.label: Downgrade
actions.detail: Do less than advised: wait and see, or treat it yourself.

actions.label: Second opinion
actions.detail: Phone 111, redo the form, or ask someone else before deciding.

followups.ask: What was the main reason?
followups.why: Codes the driver so reasons can be counted per arm and segment.

followups.ask: Tell us why in your own words.
followups.why: The quotable why.

followups.ask: Which sentence in the message mattered most to your decision? Quote it.
followups.why: Attributes the action to a message component. Verified by deleting that component and re-running.

followups.ask: In your own words, what were you told to do, and by when?
followups.why: Comprehension check. Separates did-not-understand from chose-not-to.

followups.ask: When would you actually do it?
followups.why: Proceeding late on an act-now case is still a failure.

followups.ask: How serious do you now think this is?
followups.why: Checks whether the message moved perceived severity toward the true level.

followups.ask: What would have made you follow the advice? (Only asked if they did not proceed.)
followups.why: Direct input for the next message variant.

miss_attribution.note: Computed by comparing the transcript with the hidden fact sheet. Not self-report. One tag per critical fact that the engine did not get.

tags.label: Never asked
tags.definition: No question in the transcript targets this fact.
tags.fix: Add or route to the question.

tags.label: Asked, misunderstood
tags.definition: A question targeted it, but the think-aloud shows the patient read it as something else.

tags.label: Asked, downplayed
tags.definition: The patient understood the question and gave an answer weaker than the fact sheet.

tags.label: Disclosed, engine missed
tags.definition: The fact is in the transcript and the engine still assigned too low a service.
tags.fix: Fix the engine rubric, not the channel.
